title: ‘Eagle’s Nest,’ Nazi-Era Guesthouse in German Alps, Is Gutted by Fire
summary_full: The police said on Saturday that the structure, a tourist attraction for decades, was probably not salvageable. A man was arrested in connection with the blaze.
